{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2022}}
'''John Hugh David Eland''' [[Fellow of the Royal Society|FRS]] (born 6 August 1941) is a British [[chemist]], and Fellow of [[Worcester College, Oxford]].<ref name="auto">''Who's Who 2016''. Published by Oxford University Press, 2016</ref>

Eland was educated at [[St John's School, Leatherhead]] and [[University College, Oxford]].<ref name="auto"/> He is the son of Rev. Thomas Eland and Verna Prosser Eland (née Reynolds).<ref name="auto"/>

He is the research group supervisor of the Eland group.<ref>{{Cite web | url=http://physchem.ox.ac.uk/~jhde/group.html | archive-url=https://archive.today/20120630215049/http://physchem.ox.ac.uk/~jhde/group.html | url-status=dead | archive-date=2012-06-30 | title=The Eland group: Members and research}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://news.slac.stanford.edu/features/taking-aim-electrons-atomic-scale-shooting-gallery |title=Taking Aim at Electrons: An Atomic-scale Shooting Gallery &#124; SLAC Today |accessdate=2015-05-23 |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20151022083041/https://news.slac.stanford.edu/features/taking-aim-electrons-atomic-scale-shooting-gallery |archivedate=2015-10-22 }}</ref><ref>[https://news.slac.stanford.edu/image/double-core-team-amo] {{dead link|date=June 2017}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.kurzweilai.net/x-ray-lasers-take-spectroscopy-to-a-new-extreme|title=X-ray lasers take spectroscopy to a new extreme |website=Kurzweilai.net|accessdate=2017-06-23}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://phys.org/news/2012-06-aim-electrons-atomic-scale-gallery.html|title=Taking aim at electrons: an atomic-scale shooting gallery|website=Phys.org|accessdate=2017-06-23}}</ref>
